product.olivetti-netstrada-2600.summary: The single-processor NetStrada ICS offered with either SCSI or IDE RAID.
product.olivetti-netstrada-2600.history: ICS, the Olivetti PC brand licensee, announced the NetStrada 2600 in February 2001 ahead of CeBIT. A 2002 Campania bulletin records two units at the regional employment agency.
product.olivetti-netstrada-2600.architec: RAID could keep a copy of the data on another drive. One of the Campania units used RAID 1 with two 18 GB drives.
product.olivetti-netstrada-2600.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-netstrada-2600.limitati: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-netstrada-2600.campania: Regione Campania, Bollettino Ufficiale no. 24, 13 May 2002, section 4.2
